name: AI D5 - News and posts
description: Google News RSS + LinkedIn posts per account, classified into fixed signal kinds by Sonnet 5, saved to account_intel.news_signals.

parameters.content:
## D5 - News and posts
Self-draining: claims accounts (news_attempted_at), Google News RSS per brand name (270 days, GB), keeps items that name the company, adds LinkedIn posts from D2, and only calls the model when there is something to classify. Sonnet 5, temperature 0, fixed kinds, date required, account_id echoed. Saved via intel_save_news.

parameters.text:
=You classify news items and LinkedIn posts about one UK/Irish SMB into buying signals for an employment platform. Return ONLY the JSON requested.

Company: {{ $json.name }} (industry: {{ $json.industry || "unknown" }}, HQ: {{ $json.hq || "unknown" }}, website: {{ $('Load accounts for news').item.json.domain || "unknown" }})
account_id: {{ $json.account_id }} (return this exact value, unchanged)

ITEMS
{{ $json.items.map((x, i) => "[" + i + "] source=" + x.source + " date=" + (x.date || "unknown") + " url=" + x.url + "\n" + (x.title ? x.title + " - " : "") + x.text).join("\n\n") }}

RULES
- First decide whether each item is about THIS company. Many SMBs share a name with unrelated organisations abroad or in other industries. If the item's country, industry or scale does not fit the company above, it is a different organisation: kind none.
- kind is one of: funding, expansion, new_office, project_win, people_hire, layoffs, acquisition, none. Use none for anything not clearly about THIS company or not one of those events (awards, product launches, opinion pieces, generic hiring posts with no new country or office).
- funding = the company itself raising equity or venture investment (seed, pre-seed, Series A/B, growth investment, private equity, angel round, strategic investment from a corporate venture arm). It is NOT funding when the money is a grant, a government or Innovate UK award, a charity appeal or fundraising campaign, a loan, a fund the company manages or distributes to others, or an investment the company made in someone else. Those are kind none.
- expansion = entering a new country or market, or hiring a team in another country. new_office = a named new office or site. people_hire = a new Head of People / HR / Talent / CPO or similar senior people role. project_win = a contract award or project win (construction, energy, engineering, telecoms). layoffs = redundancies or closures. acquisition = acquired or acquiring.
- event_date is YYYY-MM-DD from the item date; if the item has no date, omit the item entirely.
- url and source are copied exactly from the item. snippet is at most 30 words of the evidence, no interpretation. amount is the raise amount as written (e.g. £4m, $20 million) or empty.
- Only include items with kind other than none. signals may be an empty array.
